newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop hits high ahead of final results.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop hits high ahead of final results.

text.p: Shares of Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd rose HK$1.50 or 1.86 percent to hit an all time of HK$82.25 late Monday morning on buying ahead of the release of its final results on Wednesday, brokers said.

"Investors felt comfortable buying the stock in view of the recent good flat sales response," said Ben Kwong, director of research of Dharmala Securities. "Buying was also aided ahead of the release of its earnings report. Our estimation is about 10 percent growth in earnings."
Analysts consensus forecast predicts seven percent growth in earnings to HK$11.14 billion. -- HK Newsroom (952) 2843 6370
